message: Can you look at this ECG? I think it's normal, right?
reply:
**I wouldn’t call this ECG completely normal.** My reading from the image is:

- Regular sinus rhythm, approximately **65–70 beats/minute**.
- Widened QRS complexes with a pattern suggesting **right bundle branch block (RBBB)**, with associated ST–T changes in V1. RBBB means electrical activation of the right ventricle is delayed. [Clinical reference](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK507872/)

RBBB can be an incidental finding, but a clinician should confirm it and compare with any previous ECG—especially if this is new. An image alone can’t establish the cause or rule out an acute problem.

**If you currently have chest pain, shortness of breath, fainting, or severe dizziness, seek emergency care now.**

Was this a routine ECG, or was it taken because of symptoms?
